title: Periodic Outbound Traffic and Potential Data Transfer
closure: Not ready: destination ownership, process attribution, transfer purpose, volume baseline, and data classification require validation.

evidence.observation: Synthetic host generated repeated outbound connections to a rare external destination at regular intervals.
The destination resolved successfully but is not in the synthetic organisation allow-list.
An outbound transfer followed the connection pattern; transferred volume is available but the data type is unknown.

hypotheses: Approved application health-check or telemetry traffic
Compromised endpoint communicating with external infrastructure
lessons_learned: Periodic outbound traffic is an investigation signal, not proof of C2.
Data volume alone cannot establish exfiltration without data-type and authorisation context.
